William Craft and Ellen Craft, Running a Thousand Miles for Freedom.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-craft_ellen-craft/running-a-thousand-miles-for-freedom

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Craft, the annotator, the author and the writer of the preface, died 1900 (Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellen_and_William_Craft, William Craft (September 25, 1824 – January 29, 1900)).
- Ellen Craft, the author, died 1891 (Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellen_and_William_Craft, Ellen Craft (1826–1891)).

First publication of the text used: 1860 (SE colophon: 'Running a Thousand Miles for Freedom was published in 1860 by Ellen Craft and William Craft.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The text was first published in 1860, before 1931, so it entered the United States public domain 95 years after publication, in 1955.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and it does not change the result. Every person named above died in 1900 or earlier, the last being William Craft in 1900. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life plus 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

- William Craft: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellen_and_William_Craft, William Craft (September 25, 1824 – January 29, 1900)
